name: html-inline-button-in-paragraph-submit-semantics-fallback
description: Negative guard for inline-button-in-paragraph promotion: a typeless button with pseudo-form submit semantics (its own text reads as a submit action) still forces the paragraph to core/html, even though it has no <form> ancestor. HTML defaults a typeless button to submit, and text like "Subscribe" is real submit-intent evidence that must not be flattened into plain RichText.

source_reference.notes: Adjacent to FormControlClassifier::isPseudoFormSubmitControl(), which already treats a typeless button's submit-like text as real submit evidence outside a form (add-to-cart steppers vs. newsletter/contact submits).

legacy_comparison.reason: Negative guard for new inline-button-in-paragraph promotion.
